name: @stonedogcode/howto-demo
description: A runnable how-to built from a directory of markdown articles, with three audiences and an impersonation switcher.
//private: Never published. It is part of the repository so the package can be seen working; it is not part of the package, whose `files` list ships src/ alone.
//scripts: No `build`. The filtering lives in a dev-server middleware, so a static build would produce a site whose own /api/howto 404s — a broken artefact that looks like a working one. Moving the filtering into the client to make a build possible is the one change this demo must never accept. `type-check` covers compilation.
